notes: Groundwork for what comes next: the game now introduces itself to the server when you log in. When a version becomes too old to play, the game will say it needs updating and open the download page, instead of claiming your password is wrong. Nothing changes for now.

notes_by_language.pt_BR: Preparação para as próximas novidades: o jogo agora se apresenta ao servidor ao entrar. Quando uma versão ficar velha demais para jogar, o jogo avisa que precisa atualizar e abre a página de download, em vez de dizer que a senha está errada. Nada muda por enquanto.
notes_by_language.en_US: Groundwork for what comes next: the game now introduces itself to the server when you log in. When a version becomes too old to play, the game will say it needs updating and open the download page, instead of claiming your password is wrong. Nothing changes for now.
